questions.question: Which specimen or diagnostic finding belongs in a reference record for Endolimax nana?
options: Malaria rings inside erythrocytes in a thin blood film.
Microfilariae in a peripheral blood film.
Asymmetrical pinworm eggs on a perianal adhesive-tape specimen.
questions.explanation: Cysts or trophozoites in stool. Iodine aids cyst assessment; permanent stained smears near 1000× resolve nuclei.
